reviews.text: Good to Be Clean always provides excellent carpet cleaning! The young men were friendly, yet professional. They did a great job moving  the furniture,  cleaning that area and moving furniture back!The carpet is so clean!! They also were careful watching for small toys while working. Great Job!!

reviews.author: Mallory Cook
reviews.text: The best carpet cleaning we've ever had! Jaydon and Sutter arrived on time, and did a fantastic job with our carpets. Very kind and professional, and they completed the job in a timely manner. We will definitely use your company again! Thanks, Good To Be Clean!!

reviews.author: Sheldon Goerzen
reviews.text: This company is absolutely fantastic in every aspect. We had a serious mold problem in our crawl space and when we reached out to Good To Be Clean the process was smooth and professional from that point on. We had them do a soda blast to get rid of the mold and look at these before and after photos! We were truly impressed. Nick was excellent at explaining how the process worked and genuinely cared about making sure all our questions were answered. We even had to re-schedule their service a couple times and they were very accommodating. Please consider using Good To Be Clean because I guarantee you will be as satisfied as we were.

reviews.author: Sherri Keller
reviews.text: Sutter and Jaden were excellent.  They were professional and knowledgeable.  They were efficient.  They even pet my puppy who loves everyone.
